field.name: navigationType
field.comment: 0 or NULL: the slides are navigated with arrows; 1: with bullets; 2: with both of them; 3: with neither

field.name: timeout
field.comment: How many milliseconds a slide is displayed, which must be at least 100 more than speed

field.name: speed
field.comment: How many milliseconds the transition between two slides lasts

field.name: noAnimate
field.comment: true: the slides are not advanced on their own, and a visitor moves them by hand; false or NULL: each is replaced by the next after timeout

field.name: pause
field.comment: true: the slideshow stops while the pointer is over it; false or NULL: it keeps going

field.name: maxWidth
field.comment: The maximum width of the slideshow, in pixels (0 or NULL: no limit)

field.name: fID
field.comment: The ID of the image of the slide

field.name: linkURL
field.comment: The URL the slide links to, which wins over internalLinkCID (empty: it links to internalLinkCID)

field.name: internalLinkCID
field.comment: The ID of the page the slide links to (0 or NULL: none): it's used only when linkURL is empty

field.name: title
field.comment: The title displayed over the image, as plain text

field.name: description
field.comment: The text displayed below the title, as rich text

field.name: sortOrder
field.comment: The position of the slide in the slideshow, starting from zero
